programme.desc: Cold Water Mystery. Kalastaja ja tutkimusretkeilijä Jeremy Wade on ammattikalastajien aluksella Alaskassa etsimässä ruijanpallasta. Näkyykö 25-kiloisesta jätistä jälkeäkään? Biologi, kalastaja ja tutkimusmatkailija Jeremy Wade matkustaa ympäri maailmaa tutkimaan vesistöjä ja vesielämää. Tutkimuskohteisiin lukeutuvat muun muassa havainnot myyttisistä vesihirviöistä sekä alueet, joilta tietyt kalalajit ovat yhtäkkiä kadonneet. Iso-Britannia 2018

programme.title: Dodo Heroes
programme.desc: Kiehtovia tarinoita kipeästi avun tarpeessa olevista eläimistä ympäri maailmaa sekä ihmisistä, jotka auttavat niitä voimiaan säästelemättä. Koskettavassa sarjassa ihmiset tekevät kaikkensa, jotta pystyät auttamaan apua tarvitsevia eläimiä ympäri maailmaa. Yhdysvallat 2019

programme.title: Irwinin perheen eläintarha
programme.desc: Tiger Triplets. Bindi suunnittelee perheensä kanssa tunteikasta yllätystä Terille Crocoseumissa. Lisäksi Robert jää jumiin auttaessaan eläintarhan kolmea uutta tiikerinpentua. Irwinin perhe on vuoden kestäneiden metsäpalopelastustoimien ja surrealistisen maailmanlaajuisen pandemiasulun jälkeen valmiita uuteen kauteen ja avaavat Australian eläintarhansa uudelleen ja palaavat rakkaan työnsä pariin hoitamaan eläimiä. Australia 2021

programme.title: San Diegon eläintarha
programme.desc: Abigail the Incredible. Työntekijöillä on kovat paineet, kun vuosisadan ikäinen galápagoksenjättiläiskilpikonna laitetaan leikkaukseen. Lisäksi orvoksi jäänyt koala saa erityisen syntymäpäiväyllätyksen. Kaksi vaikutusvaltaista eläintarhaa San Diegosta avaa ovensa eläinten, hoitajien ja eläinlääkäreiden elämään. Organisaatioiden toimintaa rahoitetaan ainutlaatuisilla hankkeilla. Yhdysvallat 2020

programme.title: Maatilan pelastajat
programme.desc: Treehouse of Terror. Raneyt korjaavat romahtamispisteessä olevaa puumajaa Missourissa. Misty rakentaa puumajan kierrätetyistä ikkunoista, ja Matt rakentaa työpajan. Osa kaupunkilaisista on kyllästynyt hetkisen maailman sykkeeseen ja haluaa muttaa maalle. Maaseudulla asumisessa on kuitenkin erilaisia haasteita. Niinpä apuun kiitää eräs erityinen perhe. Yhdysvallat 2020

programme.title: Kalliovuorten eläinlääkäri
programme.desc: A First for Dr. Jeff. Eläinlääkäri Jeff tekee hengitysvaikeuksista kärsivälle koiralle leikkauksen, jollaista ei ole koskaan ennen tehnyt. Eläinlääkäri Baier pelastaa hylätyt lännenkotelokilpikonnat. Denverin intohimoisin ja periksiantamattomin eläinlääkäri Jeff Young luotsaa Planned Pethood Plus -klinikkaansa suurella sydämellä. Dr. Jeff tiimeineen hoitaa kaikenkarvaisia eläimiä sekä klinikalla että siirtymällä tarpeen tullen paikan päälle syrjäisiin kohteisiin. Iso-Britannia 2020

programme.title: Akvaariomestarit

programme.title: Animal Cops Miami
programme.desc: Biggest Rescue Ever. Eläinjulmuuksien tutkijat uivat alligaattorivesissä pelastaakseen vammautuneen alligaattorin. Miamin tähän mennessä suurimmassa kaappauksessa maatilalta pelastetaan 400 eläintä! 2010

programme.title: Animal Cops Miami
programme.desc: Manatee Rescue. Manaatin räpylän dramaattinen pelastus paljastaa salaisuuden. Tutkija Casadevall etsii salametsästäjiä, joiden hyökkäyksissä on kuollut useita karjaeläimiä. 2010

programme.title: Lone Star Law
programme.desc: Riistanvartijat saavat hälytyksen laittomasta peuranmetsästyksestä, mikä johtaa yhteenottoon. Kaksi pesukarhua tunkeutuu huoltoasemalle ja ne on saatava kiinni. Teksasin riistanvalvojat suojelevat sekä ihmisiä että eläimiä Yhdysvaltain toiseksi suurimman osavaltion laajalla alueella. Työpäivien aikana vastaan tulee kaikkea mahdollista salametsästäjistä tulvien uhreihin ja vaarallisiin villieläimiin. Yhdysvallat 2016

programme.title: Project Grizzly
programme.desc: What About Bob?. Jeff opettaa karhuja etsimään luonnosta ruokaa. Kun Bob raapaisee häntä käsivarresta, kieltäytyy hän lääkintäavusta. Jeff joutuu pohtimaan, miltä karhujen lähtö pesästä tuntuu. 2016

programme.title: Treehouse Masters
programme.desc: Puukuiskaaja Pete Nelson ja hänen tiiminsä suunnittelevat yksityisiä piilopaikkoja ihmisille, jotka haluavat löytää uudelleen yhteyden luotoon ja herättää sisäisen lapsensa. Pete Nelson tiimeineen rakentaa toinen toistaan uskomattomampia puumajoja ihmisille, jotka haluavat kosketuksiin luonnon kanssa. Yhdysvallat 2016

programme.title: Pit Bulls & Parolees
programme.desc: Tip Of The Iceberg. Tia ja Sugar pelastavat irtokoiran, joka kiidätetään suoraan eläinlääkäriin. Uusi työntekijä Darius tavoittelee unelmatyötään eläinlääkärinä. Tia Torres kuntouttaa kaltoinkohdeltuja amerikanpitbullterriereitä ehdonalaisvankien avulla Villalobosin pelastuskeskuksessa. Tekemistä riittää, kun työntekijöiden pyrkimyksenä on myös muuttaa ihmisten asenteita kiisteltyä ja pelättyä koirarotua kohtaan. Yhdysvallat 2017

programme.title: Kissakuiskaaja

programme.desc: For The Birds. Pihasuunnittelija Lucas Congdon ja hänen tiiminsä rakentavat uskomattomia uima-altaita. Rakennussuunnitelmat ovat ennennäkemättömän suuria ja täynnä ihmeellisiä yksityiskohtia. The crew turns a koi pond project into a backyard oasis for a family and their fish in Siesta Key. programme.desc: Muffy wants a Bouncy Castle at her party, but when her favorite cherry tree is cut down to make room for it, she starts to have regrets. Francine and Muffy scheme to set up their older siblings Chip and Catherine, but plans go awry.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Arthur discovers that Grandma Thora is a marbles champion, he trains with her so he can beat all his friends. Then, Brain doesn't believe in superstitions, so when he has a string of bad luck, he's stunned.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Buster's Second Chance/Arthur and the Whole Truth
programme.desc: With the help of a little time travel, Buster turns back the clock to see what his life would be like if he were a genius. Arthur isn't happy when he discovers that Buster has been telling him some white lies, just to spare his feelings.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: After visiting The Elwood City Times, Francine decides to start her own paper--The Frensky Star! The tabloid is a success--until all her friends stop speaking to her. Somebody stole D.W.'s backpack!! Who is this fluffy unicorn thief?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Will Fern give up her dreams of being a writer just because of one silly rejection? Buster tells the story of a missing cereal box on his all-new podcast. Will he be able to find the thief--and in the process--the truth?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Flea to Be You and Me/Kiss and Tell
programme.desc: Pal is itching like crazy and the culprit is Pepe, an Italian circus flea. Then, Emily returns from her summer in Paris with the amazing news that she's been kissed .... by a boy! Now can D.W. find her own Prince Charming?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: The Last Tough Customer/Brain's Chess Mess
programme.desc: The Tough Customers realize it's time to quit bullying and set out to find a new hobby--but can Molly ever truly change her ways? And Brain starts a chess club at school to improve his game and beat Los Dedos, the local chess master.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Home Sweet Home/Do You Believe in Magic
programme.desc: It’s time to celebrate summer! Join Arthur as he takes a family vacation and visits Grandpa Dave’s farm. Then, Arthur, D.W. and Buster spend a few days at the beach where they discover the simple joys of building sandcastles!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Everyone at school is speaking their own made-up language, and George can't make sense of what anyone is saying. And it's the grand opening of World Girl World, which sells dolls from every country, and every girl in town is thrilled!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Sue Ellen and Fern take a popularity quiz in a magazine and change their personalities to become more likable, but it backfires. And Buster's convinced that his great joke will be the difference between a successful oral report and failure.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: D.W. Rides Again/Arthur Makes The Team
programme.desc: In D.W.’s heart lurks one big, gnawing desire--TO GET RID OF THOSE TRAINING WHEELS! Then, can Coach Frensky work with a baseball team where everyone is fighting about who gets to be pitcher and no one wants to practice?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: A special episode of Bionic Bunny is interrupted, and Arthur and friends try to remember what comes next. D.W. is excited to be taking care of the class bunny, Larry. But Larry is feeling adventurous and and wanders off.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Night of the Tibble/Read and Flumberghast
programme.desc: The Tibble Twins are having their first sleepover! Will the Tibbles lock James in the dark basement? Then, a cupcake's been stolen! The primary suspect: Tommy Tibble. D.W. gathers a jury and demands that justice be served.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Rattles's mom starts dating Archie Vanderloo, Rattles finds himself spending time with his twins, but they don’t have anything in common. Arthur offers to babysit so that his parents can enjoy some peace and quiet in the backyard.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: What Scared Sue Ellen?/Clarissa Is Cracked
programme.desc: Sue Ellen's not afraid of much, but when she encounters a really creepy howling noise in the woods, she's scared for real. Then, Grandma Thora has a lot of fun stuff, especially her porcelain doll, Clarissa.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Around the World in 11 Minutes/Muffy and the Big Bad Blog
programme.desc: Pal, Baby Kate, Amigo, and Mei Lin enthusiastically accept Nemo's dare to travel around the world and make it back in 11 minutes. Then, Muffy discovers that web blogging is a great way to keep her readers up to date with her every move.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: The Chips Are Down/Revenge Of The Chip
programme.desc: What a mysterious, beautiful thing a green potato chip is--and D.W. just ate a gigantic one! But then she hears a rumor that they're poisonous...Sure, kids do some pretty embarrassing things, but do Moms have to tell everyone?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Buster Spaces Out/The Long Road Home
programme.desc: Inspired by footage of the moon landing, Buster wants to go to outer space someday! For now, it'd be cool to build and launch a rocket! Then, after costing Lakewood Elementary the win in a relay race, George wants to redeem himself.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Looking for Bonnie/The Secret Origin of Supernova
programme.desc: Famous rock musician Dean Lomax visits Elwood City and calls on George's dad to fix his equally famous guitar, named Bonnie. Arthur is dismayed when he learns an energy drink endorsed by his favorite comic book character is full of sugar.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur is thrilled when Dad invites him to go fly-fishing for the weekend. But a change in plans forces them to include D.W. Find out once and for all where socks disappear to when Baby Kate and Pal team up to solve the great sock mystery.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Muffy buys all of the books and dolls in the Pretty Pioneers series and invites her friends to join a pretty book club. Mom has new clients coming over and they have a daughter who is D.W.'s age. They're going to be the best of friends!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Winter hits Elwood City and Arthur sees dollar signs! His snow-shoveling business is booming--that is, until Buster decides to get in on the action. And, Brain can be a know-it-all, and sometimes he really bugs people.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Prunella Sees the Light/Return of the Snowball
programme.desc: For her sleepover with Marina, Prunella redecorates her room. But Marina is blind--will the decorations she can't see offend her, or worse, make her trip? D.W. has been trying to solve the mystery of her snowball's disappearance.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Arthur catches Buster sucking his thumb, Buster worries that Arthur will tell the entire school. Tired of doing chores, Arthur and friends decide to invent their own country. Will this kid-ruled utopia flourish or descend into anarchy?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: D.W. tells her friends that she's a fantastic skater, but she can barely stand on ice! With a skating party coming up, how will she face everyone and tell them the truth? Accused of being spoiled, Muffy sets out to prove her friends wrong.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Only four more days until Arthur's birthday party! But to Arthur's horror, it turns out Muffy's having her birthday party on the very same day. And, now that Francine finally has the lead in a school play, she's has become a stage tyrant.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Pets and Pests/Go Fly a Kite
programme.desc: There's a mouse loose in the Read home! And D.W. wants it gone…NOW! When traps fail, Arthur enlists the help of an expert mouse catcher. While playing in the park, Binky, Muffy, and Ladonna stumble upon an abandoned kite.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Fern's parents give her a cell phone for emergencies, she soon becomes hooked on it. Brain is the smartest kid in class. Everyone knows that! What they don't know is that he was kept back in Kindergarten. Will Binky spill the beans?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: What Is That Thing?/Buster's Best Behavior
programme.desc: Arthur and friends are all faced with seemingly impossible tasks, from fixing a model biplane to babysitting D.W. And, Buster knows he's fun, but he's beginning to feel like he's not particularly good at anything.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Buster's Back/The Ballad Of Buster Baxter
programme.desc: Buster's coming home! The word spreads fast, but so does the fear that Buster will be different. Then, it seems to Buster, not only have his friends changed while he was gone, but they've forgotten all about him! Will he ever fit in again?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: April 9th is a normal day until a fire destroys the teacher's lounge and forces Lakewood Elementary to close. This unexpected event finds creates a wide range of emotional reactions, for Arthur, his friends and teachers, and the community.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Brain's Easter egg hunts are notoriously hard. But this year's might prove impossible if Brain can't remember where he hid the final egg. Then, crazy coincidences have prevented Brain from seeing a meteor shower in person.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Celebrity chef Ming Tsai is judging Lakewood Elementary's first-ever cooking contest, and Arthur thinks he has a shot at winning. Then, Buster volunteers to deliver the school mail and finds out that his new job is actually hard work!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Fernlets by Fern/Prunella and the Haunted Locker
programme.desc: Muffy talks Fern into writing poems for a new line of greeting cards which becomes the hit of Elwood City, but booming business causes Fern to burn out. Prunella is assigned a new school locker, which is rumored to be haunted!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: It's bad enough to wear glasses all the time. But does Arthur have to be the last person in his class to lose his baby teeth? Then, if you think being lost in a humongous department store would scare a four-year-old, think again.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: What would happen if Arthur and his friends entered a contest to write stories for their favorite TV show? Then, look out world, D.W. has discovered science! But D.W.'s new-found passion proves that a little knowledge is a dangerous thing.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur is worried that his letters to his new Turkish pen pal, Adil, will be boring. After all, how can Elwood City compare to Arthur's fantastical ideas about Turkey? Bitzi is breaking up with her boyfriend, and Buster is really sad.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: For some reason, Arthur isn't doing very well in school anymore. Maybe he just needs some glasses? Problem is, Arthur hates having to wear them. And it's school picture day and Muffy is determined that Francine will look her best.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: You think running a marathon is hard? Try babysitting for the Terrible Tibble Twins. Next, Arthur's family is hosting the once-a-year-is-more-than-enough family reunion. But a major thunderstorm turns this into a reunion to remember.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur and Buster have always been best friends, but when a leaky roof forces Arthur to study in Buster's room, they discover that they make better friends than roommates. Arthur's ecstatic when he wins free concert tickets on the radio.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Buster Isn't Buying It/One Ornery Critter
programme.desc: Aliens, conspiracy theories, the megatoad--Buster believes in everything, until his favorite show gets cancelled for false reporting. Dogs love Arthur! Well, except Carrot Cake. Can Arthur win over this picky pup?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Muffy's Dad gives her concert tickets, she couldn't be more excited--until she discovers that she's going to the opera. And Arthur aced five quizzes in a row! But his luck runs out when Mom takes a new job.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Buster Spaces Out/The Long Road Home
programme.desc: Inspired by footage of the moon landing, Buster wants to go to outer space someday! For now, it'd be cool to build and launch a rocket! Then, after costing Lakewood Elementary the win in a relay race, George wants to redeem himself.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Kids Are From Earth, Parents Are From Pluto/Nerves Of Steal
programme.desc: It’s Lakewood Elementary Parents Open House! How will the kids survive a whole evening of their parents' embarrassing antics? Buster is the only kid in Elwood City who doesn't have a Cybertoy, so he decides to 'borrow' one from the store.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: The Last of Mary Moo Cow/Bitzi's Beau
programme.desc: When Mary Moo Cow is cancelled, D.W. is devastated. How can television--or life as she knows it--ever be the same? Buster hasn't yet met Bitzi's new boyfriend, but he fears the worst. What if he is a Mom-stealer?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur is not too sure he's ready for a new baby in the house. What do babies do besides cry? Then, living with a baby is no picnic. Just how long will Baby Kate be hanging around, anyway? And who would even miss D.W. if she ran away?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur is not too sure he's ready for a new baby in the house. What do babies do besides cry? Then, living with a baby is no picnic. Just how long will Baby Kate be hanging around, anyway? And who would even miss D.W. if she ran away?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Muffy posts a goofy video of Francine on the Muffington Post, Francine worries she will become the laughing stock of the entire school. And it's the 1st Annual Lakewood Derby and Muffy's revved up!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: D.W.'s Deer Friend/Buster Hits the Books
programme.desc: The Reads go on a camping trip, and D.W. wants to bring a little bit of nature back home--a rather large deer named Walter! Next, Buster got through school without ever reading a book. But now he has to read one in just a week!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: So Funny I Forgot to Laugh/The Best Day Ever
programme.desc: Arthur thinks his jokes about Sue Ellen's new sweater are in good fun but Sue Ellen's feelings are hurt. Has Arthur become a bully? Everyone is reminiscing about their "best days." Except Arthurs. Is it possible he doesn't have one?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Carl's Concerto/Too Much of a Good Thing
programme.desc: Carl has agreed to play the accordion for George's puppet show. But his routines are getting in the way of rehearsals. Buster enlists Binky's help to keep him from gorging on delicious Tuvaluna cookies. Will Buster's self-control crumble?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Arthur Makes A Movie/Go to Your Room!
programme.desc: Too young to see a real "James Hound" movie, the kids decide they'll make a film of their own. Next, how would YOU like to be four years old and completely misunderstood by your parents? And then be sent to your room for ten whole minutes?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Brain dreams of being the first to spot a rare bird species called the green-tailed grebe, making him famous. Arthur and Buster's friendship is put to the test when Arthur gives away a present that Buster had given him for his birthday.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Attention Lakewood Elementary! There's a new sheriff—er--hallway monitor-in town, and his name is George Lundgren. Ladonna Compson is friendly, funny, and full of personality. Everyone likes her! At least, that's what she thought.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Muffy embarks on a quest to find her long lost imaginary friend. And then it's Catherine's 16th birthday, and Francine has been cordially UN-invited to the party.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Binky discovers that he's allergic to peanuts, he has so many questions, but learns that the best way not to go nuts is to be well informed and to understand his allergy. Much to his horror, Brain gets a "B-" on a test.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Sue Ellen Gets Her Goose Cooked/Best of The Nest
programme.desc: Sue Ellen is the champion of the popular Internet game, Virtualgoose.com, but she’s become obsessed! And now the gang has moved onto Best of the Nest. Will any of his friends be willing to forgo their computers for a real, live adventure?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Arthur The Wrecker/Arthur and The True Francine
programme.desc: Arthur always seems to wreck things, and this time it's Mom's computer. Can he get it fixed before Mom finds out? Then, Muffy A. Crosswire and Francine are absolute best friends, despite their rather obvious differences.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur has a hard time resisting sweets, and one evening his overindulgence wins him an upset stomach and some 'Grimm' dreams. Arthur and D.W. loved it when Grandpa Dave came to visit--but now he only wants to sleep and play checkers.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: The Boy Who Cried Comet/Arthur and Los Vecinos
programme.desc: Buster is convinced that he's seen real UFO's, and he uses Muffy's fancy new telescope to get the proof. Then, Mr. Sipple from next door is moving away and Arthur wonders--who will be the new neighbors?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: There’s a mock election in Mr. Ratburn's class, but Muffy takes it seriously. How far will she go to win? Francine can't believe it. She gets in trouble no matter what she does -- thanks to the new nosy next-door neighbor!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Attack Of The Turbo Tibbles/D.W. Tricks The Tooth Fairy
programme.desc: If you think the Tibbles are bad now, imagine what they'd be like if they had super powers! Then, D.W. needs money, quick. When she tries to pull a fast one on the Tooth Fairy, will Arthur have to pay?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: The Case of the Girl with the Long Face/The Substitute Arthur
programme.desc: Fern's been feeling low and no one can figure out why. Luckily, Buster Baxter is on the case! With Arthur out of town, Buster is on the hunt for a new best friend, but he only wants to play games HIS way. Will Buster learn to compromise?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Buster’s Uncle Bob – portrayed by special guest R.L. Stine – comes to visit and tells Buster a spooky bedtime story. Then, Cheikh learns that he and his family will become American citizens!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Binky's family has decided to adopt a little girl from China. The thought of a baby sister makes Binky happy, until he realized there are some changes in store. It’s a lot harder than he thought, but it has its rewards too.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur and his friends commemorate their 100th episode in style! Mr. Ratburn's class is chosen to stage a musical tribute to Elwood City for its centennial celebration, which quickly becomes a drama behind the curtain!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Grandma Thora teaches Arthur to knit and he's really into this new hobby. But…he's a kid! And a boy! Knitting is a grandma thing, right? And, Muffy wants to rock the fashion world, but creating a fad is a lot harder than it looks.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: The Butler Did...What?/The Trouble with Trophies
programme.desc: Bailey is missing! Muffy discovers a series of clues and is left wondering, who exactly IS Bailey? Then, everyone loves getting trophies, right? It turns out that Fern could not care less about them.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: The World of Tomorrow/Is There a Doctor in the House?
programme.desc: Since Binky's repeating third grade, he's totally dreading Mr. Ratburn's annual class sleepover at the Science Museum. Arthur and D.W. face the ultimate challenge when Mom gets a bad cold and then gives it to Dad!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Buenas Noches, Vicita/Prunella Packs It In
programme.desc: Vicita Molina has lost her favorite bedtime book – can Arthur help her re-create it? Prunella is already starting to think about college! Will she crack under the heavy load or will she learn to relax and do the things she actually enjoys?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When D.W. discovers that she can get her own library card, she rejoices at the world of books waiting for her. And, is it ever okay to hit someone? Sometimes you just get so mad, you wanna....pow! Right??

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Arthur's Toy Trouble/Spar for the Course
programme.desc: It's a race to the toy store after Arthur realizes he may have given away his chance at 2 million dollars! Unless Muffy, Buster, and Binky can comprise, they'll be stuck with a boring windmill at the new 18th hole at the mini golf course.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: D.W. wants to be the first person to set foot on Mars! But what if scary purple aliens eat her? Who's responsible for cracking Dad's cake platter? DUN-DUN! All the evidence points to Arthur!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Mom and Dad Have A Great Big Fight/D.W.'s Perfect Wish
programme.desc: When Mom and Dad fight over spilled milk, Arthur and D.W. fear the worst. Is it Arthur's fault or D.W.'s? Then, turning five is a major, big deal event! But D.W. worries that she fribbled away her preschool years on meaningless pursuits.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Sue Ellen Adds It Up/Wish You Were Here
programme.desc: Math, schmath. That's what Sue Ellen thinks… until she runs into a problem her artistic vision can't solve. Sue Ellen can't wait to meet her pen pal in person.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Prunella's Special Edition/The Secret Life Of Dogs & Babies
programme.desc: The latest book about everyone's favorite boy wizard--Henry Skreever--is finally out! Every kid in town is lining up to get it, except Prunella, who's ordered a limited edition from England. Ever wonder what Baby Kate and Pal are thinking?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Arthur's Faraway Friend/Arthur and The Square Dance
programme.desc: Arthur's in the midst of writing a great adventure story with Buster when he gets some very bad news--Buster is leaving town to go live with his Dad for a while. Then, does Francine have a crush on Arthur?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: The Agent of Change/D.W. Unties the Knot
programme.desc: The latest animated hit movie about a boy and his truck has left Muffy and Francine disappointed. Why doesn't there seem to be any cool female characters on screen? After watching "The Wedding Channel," D.W. wants to get married!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Francine's Bubbe passes away, Muffy tries to understand how she can help her friend. Then, when Arthur's family goes on the same vacation they take every year, he and Buster try to make it more exciting.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Arthur and The Crunch Cereal Contest/D.W. Flips
programme.desc: A year's supply of Crunch Cereal is in store for the person who can write the new Crunch Cereal jingle, and Arthur is sure he can do it. Next, how hard can it be to do a cartwheel on a balance beam? D.W. is about to find out.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Arthur And The Big Riddle/Double Dare
programme.desc: Alex Trebek lends his voice as gameshow host Alex Lebek in this episode which poses the age-old riddle--is winning really everything? What if your friends dared you to skip homework--and then double dared you to skip school?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Arthur's Treasure Hunt/The Return Of The King
programme.desc: When Buster digs up an ancient arrowhead, everyone else wants to hunt for buried treasures, too. And a field trip to the Medieval Fair pits Arthur's class against another led by Ratburn's super-tough mentor, Mr. Pryce-Jones.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Prunella the Packrat/What's in a Name?
programme.desc: Prunella saves everything. Can Arthur help her break her packrat habits in time to put together the display for the school's Earth Day fair? Binky find out that his real name isn't Binky--it's Shelley?!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Arthur Goes Crosswire/Sue Ellen And The Brainasaurous
programme.desc: Since they rescued Wilbur Rabbit, Arthur and Muffy have been inseparable. But the rest of their friends are growing tired of the new Arthur. And, Brain's a great partner for a school assignment--unless you wanted to work on it, too!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: To earn the money for a new video game, Arthur decides to sell his old toys through his school's Web site. The Tibble Twins want to take Grandmother out to dinner, but she'd rather stay home. Is it because of their terrible table manners?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Postcards from Buster, Parts I & II
programme.desc: Buster's going to New York City to meet his dad Bo, and the Reads are coming with him! He's thrilled ... but won't his mom miss him? But, Bitzi gives him a present that will let him share his exciting trip with her--a video camera!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: The gang can't agree on rules for their club, and each starts his own. Next, Francine's embarrassed by her crummy old bike. Why can't she have a shiny new one like all her friends?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Arthur's Family Vacation/Grandpa Dave's Old Country Farm
programme.desc: What's got moldy bathrooms, lumpy beds and lots of rain? Arthur's family vacation. Then, Arthur and D.W. go to visit their grandfather, but the visit doesn't turn out as expected, because Grandpa Dave isn't your usual kind of grandfather.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.sub-title: Baby Kate and the Imaginary Mystery/Strangers on a Train
programme.desc: Nadine, D.W.'s imaginary friend is missing. Sue Ellen can't wait to travel on an old-fashioned train, but once onboard, she discovers that the train is not as spectacular as she had hoped–until she finds a mysterious diary.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Once again, Arthur gets to do everything. Mostly he gets to carry the ring in Aunt Lucy's wedding. Elwood City's park is in sad shape, and after grumbling about it, the kids find themselves volunteered to clean it up.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Mrs. MacGrady is diagnosed with cancer, Arthur and his friends all react differently to the news. The kids must learn how to come together to help support each other and Mrs. MacGrady.

programme.title: Arthur

programme.desc: It's a nightmare--Arthur and Buster have to work with Binky. On an art project! I mean, what does a bully like Binky know about art? Then, Arthur discovers the secret to success--a pencil that brings good luck to whoever possesses it.

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha Mossy air bhioran gus a charaid ùr, Fred, a thoirt gu cruinneachaidh-cluich an sgioba. Ge-tà ‘s e deargann a th’ ann am Fred ‘s chan eil càch cho toilichte a leithid fhaicinn nam measg... gus an seall Fred g’ eil e feumail na dhòigh fhèin! Mossy is excited to bring his new friend, Fred, to today’s playdate, but the rest of the gang are less than enamoured when they learn that Fred is actually a flea! However, Fred soon shows that he is quite useful to have around!

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha bràmair aig Bernie ‘s tha i gus tighinn gu dìnnear a-nochd! Ge-tà, chan eil dad a dh'fhios aig Bernie dè chuireas e air dòigh! Tha Oona ‘s Baba ag aontachadh a chuideachadh ach, le Mossy nam meag, saoil am bi biadh air fhàgail mus nochd i? Bernie has a girlfriend – and she’s on her way to the grotto for dinner! However, Bernie has no idea what to prepare for her! Oona and Baba agree to help him out but, with Mossy joining the fray, will there be any food left for the special guest?

programme.title: Boban is Fuigheag
programme.desc: Tha Fuigheag a’ faighinn trèat ’son a cho-là-breith an-diugh ach, gu mì-fhortanach, chan eil cùisean ag obrachadh a-mach, mar bu chòir! Fuigheag is getting a birthday treat today, but things don’t work out as they should!

programme.title: Losgannan | Froglets
programme.desc: Tha Sif, Pipp agus Bran a’ dol a chladhach airson ionmhais àrsaidh san t-sloc-gainmhich. Ziff, Pipp and Button set out to unearth ancient treasures buried in the garden sandpit.

programme.title: Sionnach agus Maigheach (Fox & Hare)
programme.desc: Tha Maigheach, Sionnach, Comhachag agus Tosg a’ faighinn cuireadh gu geama croquet còmhla ri Feòrag. Cò tha a’ nochdadh gun fhiathachadh ach Seoc! Chan eil diù aige do riaghailtean agus tha e a’ milleadh a’ ghnothaich air càch. Dìreach mus fheum iad uile sguir a chluich tha Maigheach a’ cur car anns na riaghailtean agus a’ toirt a chreidsinn air Seoc gu bheil e ri cealgaireachd an uair a tha e ann an dha-rìribh a’ cluich a’ gheama dìreach mar bu chòir. Brush invites Hare, Fox, Owl and Tusk for a fancy game of croquet. Jack shows up uninvited and wants to play, too. But being a villain, he can’t stand rules and ruins the game for everyone. Just at the moment the friends are about to give up, Hare reverses the rules to make Jack think he’s cheating but in fact he’s playing the game perfectly.

programme.title: Pompon Am Mathan Beag/Pompon Little Bear
programme.desc: Gus nach tachair an aon rud a-màireach, ithidh Pompon biadh “glan” gus nach bi aige ri fhiaclan a ghlanadh. Ach a' cheist mhòr: a bheil a leithid a rud ann ri biadh glan? Pompon missed the sun rising as he had to clean his teeth. To avoid the same happening tomorrow, Pompon decides to eat 'clean' food so as to avoid brushing his teeth. But is there such a thing as 'clean' food?

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachdan do chlann òga. Tha Angela NicAoidh a’ leughadh Rionnag ann an Sileagan. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh agus a dhealbhachadh le Sam Hay agus chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Jo NicDhòmhnaill. A bedtime story for young children. Angela Mackay reads Rionnag ann an Sileagan, written and illustrated by Sam Hay and translated into Gaelic by Jo Macdonald.

programme.title: SpongeBob
programme.desc: Tha Mgr. Crùbag a’ cur Laraidh os cionn an taigh-bìdh rè ùine. Mr Krabs makes Larry the Lobster temporary manager.

programme.title: An Sgoil
programme.desc: Latha eile aig Sgoil Taobh na Cloiche agus tha Mrs NicArtair air tàlant ùr a lorg sa chlas ealain aice. Chan eil an Tidsear Stiùiridh, Mgr Hobson, cinnteach gur e tàlant a th’ air cùlaibh na h-ealaine ach ma dh'fhaoidte trioblaid! Aig an aon àm, tha Mgr Mackle a’ dèanamh oidhirp a bhith nas fhallaine. Mrs MacArthur has unearthed a new talent in her art class. Mr Hobson is not so sure if it is talent or perhaps a more troubling issue that’s behind the artwork. Meanwhile, Mr Mackle is busy with a new health kick.

programme.title: Flix
programme.desc: Tha pàrantan Munchkin air earbs’ a chur ann, an cafaidh aca a ruith ’son a’ chiad turas, is chan eil e ’son fàiligeadh. Ri linn sin, tha Tabaidh is Flix ‘son a chuideachadh le obair-frithealaidh – ach saoil am bith iad feumail dha? Munchkin’s parents put their faith in him to run their cafe for the first time, and he doesn’t want to fail. As a result, Tabaidh and Flix want to help with serving, but will they be of any use?

programme.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan/Bottersnikes and Gumbles
programme.desc: Tha Cuirm na Granndachd a’ gabhail àit’ far am faigh iad a mach cò as gràinnde de na Bògaisean. Ach cò an Gumbal a tha na Ghumbal nam Beachd? The Ugly Pageant is taking place where they decide on the ugliest Bògais. But which Gumbal is the Ideas-gumbal?

programme.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan/Bottersnikes and Gumbles
programme.desc: Nuair a tha Bonns a-muigh a’ lorg biadh airson na bangaid meadhan-oidhche, tha na Cnuimhean ga ghlacadh ’s ga chur am bruid. Ciamar a gheibh e air adhart an dèidh sin? When Bonns is out finding food for his 12-course midnight snack, the Cnuimhean catch and kidnap him. How will he get on after that?

programme.title: Fillte
programme.desc: Fillte, goes on a journey throughout Scotland to discover the history, and contemporary hand-crafted practice behind the artisan producers of woven fabrics, such as wool, hemp, linen, grasses, leather, and many more unorthodox fabrics. Tha Fillte a gabhail turas tro Alba a’ sireadh eachdraidh agus sgeulachdan an latha ’n diugh co-cheangailte ris an luchd-ciùird a tha snìomh ‘s ag obrachadh diofar stuthan, leithid, clòimh, corcach, anart, feur,leathar, agus iomadh seorsa stuth iongantach eile.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: Tha Joy Dunlop gar toirt tro na ciad ceumannan gus Gàidhlig a bhruidhinn. Coinnichidh sinn ris an neach-ionnsachaidh Sophie Day às an Eaglais Bhreac, agus tha Calum MacIlleathain a’ lorg ìomhaigh ann an uamh air Eilean Dà Bharra far Maol Chinn Tìre. Joy Dunlop continues to guide us through the first basic steps to speak Gaelic. We meet learner Sophie Day from Falkirk, and Calum Maclean keeps a keen eye on the tide whilst on the hunt for spectacular cave art on Davaar Island in the Mull of Kintyre.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Mas Fhior
programme.desc: Farpais-cheist do-chreidsinneach... Mas Fhìor! Le ochdnar Mas Fhìoraich a’ cluich bhon dachaighean fhèin, ’s iad an fheadhainn a chuireas na ceistean agus na freagairtean. An urrainn do Kerrie is Ceitidh agus Beniamin is Calum a tha a’ cluich bhon stiùideo, a’ chùis a dhèanamh orra airson an duais mhòr a bhuannachadh? A quiz show that is pretty unbelievable! Eight pretenders play from the comfort of their own homes and hold all the questions and answers to this quiz. Can Kerry and Katie, with Benjamin and Calum in the studio, beat the Pretenders for a chance to win a cash prize? In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Trusadh
programme.desc: Na tha e ciallachadh a bhith dol tro làn-sgur fuil-mìosa san là an-diugh. What it means to go through the menopause today.

programme.title: An Clo Mor
programme.desc: The community gathers for a fundraiser ceilidh for Old Mary who is recovering from her mill accident. A drunken Boyd confronts Mairead and Cairistiona in front of everyone at the ceilidh. Things turn sour between Johan and Murdina resulting in a mysterious fire starting at the hotel, trapping Murdina and Boyd inside. Will they make it out alive? Tha a’ choimhearsnachd a’ cruinneachadh aig cèilidh gus airgead a thogail do Mhàiri, a tha fhathast a’ faighinn seachad air an tubaist aice ‘sa mhuileann. Tha smùid air Boyd ‘s e a’ cur aghaidh air Mairead ‘s Cairistiona air beulaibh a h-uile duine aig a’ chèilidh. Tha cùisean a’ dol ceàrr eadar Johan is Murdina, a’ fàgail gu bheil teine a’ tòiseachadh anns an taigh-òsta – le Murdina agus Boyd glaiste na bhroinn. Am faigh iad às beò? In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Am Balla (The Wall)
programme.desc: Tha Ramsay MacMahon ag ionnsachadh mu bheatha air a’ chrìoch eadar an Fhionnlainn agus an Ruis. Bho thug an Ruis ionnsaigh air an Ucràin ann an 2022 tha a’ chrìoch air dùnadh gu tur, ag atharrachadh beatha dhaoine air gach taobh. Anns an Fhionnlainn, cluinnidh Ramsay sgeulachdan bho theaghlaichean a chaidh a’ sgaradh bho an luchd-gràdh air taobh eile na crìche. Coinnichidh e riuthsan air a bheil an dleastanas ‘son tèarainteachd aig a’ chrìoch agus cluinnidh e bho dhaoine a chaill am beòshlaint’ gu h-obann air sgàth an dùnaidh. Ramsay MacMahon learns about life along the border between Finland and Russia. Since Russia’s attack on Ukraine in 2022 the border has closed completely, transforming the lives of people on both sides. In Finland, Ramsay hears the stories of families who have been separated from their loved ones on the other side, meets those responsible for securing the border and hears from people who have lost their livelihood overnight because of its closure. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Skipinnish Aig A' Chaisteal
programme.desc: Skipinnish le Alba and Nelson Mandela ann an cuideachd na mìltean de luchd-leantainn aig cuirm-chiùil a’ comharrachadh 25 bliadhna de Skipinnish, bho Chaisteal Dhùn Èideann. Skipinnish perform Alba and Nelson Mandela in front of thousands of fans at a concert celebrating 25 years of the band, from Edinburgh Castle.

programme.title: Glan Fhèin
programme.desc: Angela and Katie compete against Shonnie and Calum from rival company Sgiobalta. It’s an upstairs-downstairs, girls v boys clean-off where the winner gets the contract. Things get messy, featuring stains, smudges and romantic complications. The timing isn’t perfect, as it clashes with the anniversary of Katie’s infamous disastrous reality TV appearance. Meanwhile, Betty and Dido are on a publicity push where they ditch leaflets and embrace dancing on social media. And Daniel makes a new furry friend as he gets busy with his air freshener.

programme.title: Cleasan Ataidh & Tilidh/The Adventures of Abney & Teal
programme.desc: ’S e latha air leth fliuch a th’ ann, is tha Àtaidh a’ lorg toll ann am mullach an taighe. An uair sin tha e a’ mothachadh gu bheil tuill ann an tòrr rudan san taigh aige. Tha e a’ co-dhùnadh toll a chladhach dha fhèin, ach tha e a' steigeadh ann! Ciamar a gheibh Tilidh, Nìp agus na Boga-bogadaich às e? It is a very rainy day and Abney finds a hole in his roof. Then he starts to notice holes everywhere. He decides to dig one of his own but gets stuck in it! How will Teal, Neep and the Poc-Pocs get him out?

programme.title: Dan & Gran
programme.desc: Stan and Gran find a mysterious old carved piece of wood while they are beachcombing. Is it from the wreck of Porthole Pete or a carving of a mermaid? Tha Dan is Gran a' lorg seann phìos fiodha dìomhair a tha snaidht', fhad 's a tha 'd ri lorg-mhuraig. Bheil e ceangailt' ri tubaist mhara seann Peadar a' Phuirt Bhàin, no 'n e maighdeann-mhara shnaidht' a th' ann?

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachdan do chlann òga. Tha Eilidh NicCarmaig a’ leughadh Daoine Beaga, Aislingean Mòra: Ella Fitzgerald. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh le Sanchez Vegara agus a dhealbhachadh le Maria Isabel. Chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Mòrag Stiùbhart. A bedtime story for young children. Eilidh Cormack reads Daoine Beaga, Aislingean Mòra: Ella Fitzgerald by Sanchez Vegara, illustrated by Maria Isabel and translated into Gaelic by Morag Stewart.

programme.title: Hilda
programme.desc: Tha rudeigin dìomhair mun nighean ùr a th’ air an t-sràid – agus dè an gnothach a th’ aice ri trom-laighe Dhaibhidh? Tha Hilda airson a chuideachadh gus am faigh e seachad air an eagal a th’ air aig àm cadail. There is something mysterious about the new girl on the street. And what does she have to do with Daibhidh’s nightmares? Hilda wants to help him get over his fear of night time.

programme.title: Dùbhlain CBBC Alba
programme.desc: Hannah NicKirdy le sùil air ais air cuid de na dùbhlain a chaidh fheuchainn air CBBC ALBA san ùine a chaidh seachad. Hannah McKirdy takes a look at some of the crazy challenges attempted by the CBBC Alba team, including some very competitive cabbage rolling!

programme.title: Geamaichean Gorach
programme.desc: Tha Olaidh agus Coinneach ann an Ruisia agus chan e dìreach sgìtheadh a tha a’ gabhail àite oir tha sinn a’ faicinn tanca, saighdearan a’ caismeachd agus…. geama leigeil-shaighdear? Olaidh and Coinneach are in Russia but skiing isn’t the only thing that’s going on - there’s a tank to be seen, soldiers marching and....a game of skittles?

programme.title: A-null ’s a-nall
programme.desc: Tha Denis 10 bliadhna a dh'aois. Tha fadachd mhòr air gus am bi e cheart cho comasach is fèillmhor ri a bhràthair mòr, Marcus. Ge-tà, le beagan oidhirp’, tha Denis a’ sealltainn dhaibh uile g’ eil e cheart cho tàlantach, na dhòigh fhèin! Denis is ten years old. He is desperate to be as capable and popular as his older brother, Marcus. However, with a bit of effort, Denis shows everyone that he is equally talented, in his own way!

programme.title: Seòid a' Chidsin - The Kitchen Coves
programme.desc: Tha na seòid a’ feuchainn rud a-mach às an àbhaist ‘s a’ dèanamh biadh bhèagan. The lads venture out of their comfort zone and go plant-based.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: Musician and learner Andrew Findlater joins Joy in the studio and Calum Maclean takes an earthly walk, provoking thoughts of space and the galaxies around us.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Rùm Gu Rùm, Le Erica
programme.desc: Actress, turned interior designer, Erica Macpherson, takes us on a design adventure throughout the Highlands and Islands. With the help of local craft workers she finds new ideas for designing old spaces. Tha an cleasaiche, a tha a-nis na dealbhaiche cruthachail thaighean, Erica Nic a’ Phersain, a’ gabhail sgrìob tron Ghàidhealtachd ‘s na h-Eileanan. Le taic bho luchd-ciùird, tha i a’ lorg dhòighean ùra air seann rumanan a thoirt beò. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Duncan Mackenzie - Dileab a' Ghlinne
programme.desc: Dealas stàcair do dhachaigh a shinnsearan ann an Gleann Inbhir Làthail faisg air Ulapul. Local historian and deerstalker Duncan Mackenzie’s passion for Inverlael Glen, near Ullapool.

programme.title: Trusadh
programme.desc: Na tha e ciallachadh a bhith dol tro làn-sgur fuil-mìosa san là an-diugh. What it means to go through the menopause today.

programme.title: Fonn mo Bheatha
programme.desc: Taghadh den ceòl is òrain bhon seinneadairean 's luchd-ciùil a bha an sàs san t-sreath. A selection of music and song from the series.

programme.title: Alleluia!
programme.desc: Salm 68 air a sheinn le Norrie MacÌomhair agus Sìneag Nic an t-Saoir, an laoidh Mìorbhail Ghràis le Màiri Nic Aonghais agus bidh Donna Barden ag innse mun phàirt a th' aig creideamh na beatha fhèin. Tha am prògram air aithris le Iain MacFhionghain. Psalm 68 sung by Norrie MacIver, the hymn Mìorbhail Ghràis by Mairi MacInnes and Donna Barden tells her personal faith story. Presented by Iain MacKinnon.

programme.desc: Four women, all survivors of the same dangerous man, join forces to end their nightmare and bring him to justice. Jenni, Natalie, Shannon and Robyn waive their anonymity to tell their story in chilling detail, laying bare the confusion, intricacies and frightening realities of coercive control, and revealing how they became trapped by serial predator and sex abuser Aaron Swan. programme.title: Question Time
programme.desc: Fiona Bruce presents an hour of debate from Worthing, with politicians, commentators and members of the public. The UK government has backed plans by former minister Alan Milburn for sweeping reforms to prevent 'losing a generation' of young people to a life on benefits, and this week’s EU-UK talks are going 'down to the wire' according to Downing Street. Fiona Bruce presents an hour of topical debate from Worthing, debating Neets, rejoining the EU and old Brexit wounds, the housing crisis and Labour’s housing targets, and which politician, in the panel’s opinion, would make a good Bond villain. On the panel are Labour’s former foreign secretary David Lammy; the Conservatives’ shadow work and pensions minister Joe Robertson; Adrian Ramsay of the Green Party; the entrepreneur Alex Depledge; and the Times columnist Fraser Nelson.

programme.title: Honey
programme.desc: Martha is annoyed after Kurt steals their joint credit for locating Kamilla, and she vows to gain access to the scientist alone. A competitive Kurt promises to do the same. Eager for a win, Martha and Kurt attempt to insinuate their way into Friedrich’s confidence to find Greta. Stung by his reaction, Martha steals a prized possession.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Eric Knowles visits Nottingham’s Gothic revival cathedral to learn how conservators are revealing 19th-century artwork under decades of plaster and paint. Designed in 1842 by architect Augustus Pugin, the cathedral’s interior was whitewashed in the 1960s. Pugin is widely admired for his work on some of Britain’s most famous buildings, including the Palace of Westminster. Conservator Ana Logreira shows Eric how they are using digitally created stencils to renovate the cathedral’s historic interior. At Southwell Racecourse in Nottinghamshire, red team uncle and niece Russ and Lily are up against twin sisters Angie and Tamsin in blue. With just 60 minutes to buy three items, Russ makes an early pit stop at a stall selling boxed toy cars. Meanwhile, a marcasite brooch catches the sisters’ attention, but expert Irita Marriott isn’t convinced it will dazzle the bidders. Trying to hammer out a profit for the teams in Nottingham is auctioneer Hettie Jago, who has her eye on the jewellery among the lots.

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc: Game show in which 24 players compete to score points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the Impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day. In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the quiz show where a team of four – in this episode, family and friends Amy, JP, Nic and Alan – take on the Bridge of Lies. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie and the Bridge will halve their money, step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash.

programme.title: Coast to Coast Food Festival
programme.desc: Colin Murray discovers a brown sauce revival and the advantages of getting fish from a fishmonger as he visits Derry/Londonderry’s Walled City Market. Briony May Williams explores how Somerset is rivalling France in cheese productions, and Onkar Singh Purewal discovers the secrets of beekeeping. Chef Julie Lin is in Dundee, finding out how bakers keep up with demand around the clock.

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael starts a new railway journey in Newcastle, heading north to Berwick-upon-Tweed. His route takes in the River Tyne, Hadrian’s Wall, a former mining village and the fishing port of Amble.

programme.title: Trawlermen: Hunting the Catch
programme.desc: As Storm Arwen hits UK waters, Victory Rose decides when to take shelter from the storm. Crabber Siwrengale has three days to make a week’s wages, and Revival goes in search of North Sea prawns.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team head for Coughton Court in Warwickshire, where the experts get excited about an Agatha Christie letter and a rare china figure of the Queen on horseback.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: This episode comes from Oxford Union, right in the heart of central Oxford. Paul Martin is joined by experts Christina Trevanion and Will Axon. Together the team pick out a selection of interesting antiques and collectables to be sold at a local auction. Will uncovers some salacious etchings by a very famous artist, while Christina finds a unique autograph book, but will it reach for the stars or languish at the bottom of the bill? Paul also gets the chance to explore behind the scenes at Oxford Union to discover a few of the famous faces who debated in the chamber.

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Catherine Bohart, Chesney Hawkes, Rebecca Keatley and Jason Mohammad take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, Michael Sheen. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games wheelie luggage, or will they be tempted by the House of Games skateboard?

programme.title: Strictly - It Takes Two
programme.desc: Ellie Taylor kicks off the week by having an exclusive chat with the latest couple to bow out from Strictly. Friday’s all-star panel return to break down the weekend action from the Tower Ballroom.

programme.desc: A weekly programme from the BBC World Service, bringing forensic journalism from all corners of the world by BBC Eye, the World Service's critically acclaimed investigative unit, and featuring expert global correspondents getting to the heart of the biggest international stories. In this episode: Nomsa Maseko reports from South Africa, where a series of shocking murders has exposed the dangers that women face. Plus BBC Eye reveals new evidence showing how scouts, agencies and powerful fashion figures helped Jeffrey Epstein gain access to young women after his conviction for sex offences. And BBC Urdu joins women in Pakistan who are challenging traditional barriers by taking to the road on motorbikes, gaining new independence in a country where riding has long been considered off-limits to many women.

Clive Myrie hosts and asks questions on Marilyn Monroe, the influential author Katherine Mansfield, the award-winning television series The Sopranos and the German mathematician Carl Friedrich Gauss.

programme.title: Only Connect

For example: what connects Toe Martin, Shadow Fury, Tonsil Draper and Jiminy Stokes?

programme.title: University Challenge

programme.title: Lucy Worsley's Keys to the Castle

She has a close shave in the dreaded Council of Ten's torture chamber, discovers a 24-carat gold staircase that leads to one of the biggest rooms in Europe, and encounters hidden doors and secret messages.

programme.title: Peelers: The PSNI for Real
programme.desc: In Portadown, Lee and Sarah keep a careful watch as the pubs and clubs spill out. A man harangues Stephen, accusing him of refusing to take his own mother to the bingo. Eventually, he is sent packing, and Stephen reveals his mother does not play bingo. Back in Belfast, Jade, Tom, Perri and Adam spot a row outside shops where young people say their money has been stolen by a woman. CCTV suggests the man she is with may also have headbutted a passer-by. The man violently resists arrest, fighting, spitting and shouting sectarian abuse at Tom and Adam. By contrast, his partner tries to bond with her arresting officers.

One drunken night, feeling frustrated by the case and overprotective of his own daughter Miriam, Joe along with Chrissie drives the prime suspect Jason Burleigh into the woods and kills him. A reworking of Bill Gallagher’s hard-hitting thriller for the big screen.

The mystery deepens when there appears to be no evidence of how he could have left the island. In Aviemore, a rock festival erupts into violence. In Inverness, officers hunt a man after a woman is attacked in a cemetery, while campers in Fort William take a wrong turn.

Getting up close to three chicks, he discovers how DNA sampling is helping to tackle the theft of these remarkable birds. Along the way, the programme revisits memorable Countryfile wildlife encounters, from dolphins off Anglesey to spectacular starling murmurations at Newport Wetlands.

programme.desc: By the start of the new millennium, the three chefs had changed British dining forever. This episode follows what happens when the rivalry that made them gets harder to walk away from than to feed, and brings them together for the first time in decades, exploring how each man handled the success he had fought for. Will time have healed old wounds, or will old rivalries still burn brightly?

Zuerst versucht er alles, um sich wieder wichtig zu fühlen, doch am Ende versteht er: Auf einem U-Boot zählt jede Flosse gleich viel. programme.title: Submarine Jim (23)
programme.desc: Käpt'n Jim hat eine Schleck-Manie entwickelt. Er schleckt einfach alles ab, denn dann, so denkt er, gehört es ihm. Damit schlabbert er sich aber richtig ins Abseits und fällt krankheitsbedingt aus. Plötzlich steht die große Frage im Raum: Wer übernimmt das Kommando? Siggi beruft sich sofort auf Paragrafen und Protokolle, während Bianca ganz klar findet, dass sie als beste Freundin mindestens genauso qualifiziert ist. Die Lösung? Beide werden kurzerhand Co-Kapitänin und Co-Käpt'n. Doch zwei Köpfe auf einer Brücke sorgen schnell für doppelte Befehle, dreifaches Chaos und eine Besatzung am Rande des Seetangs. Als das U-Boot schließlich auf direktem Kurs ins klebrige Teer-Verderben treibt, müssen Bianca und Siggi lernen, dass wahre Leitung nicht im Rechthaben liegt - sondern im Zusammenarbeiten. Und Jim? Der träumt sich derweil durch Fieberwellen.

Währenddessen findet auch eine große Bedrohung ihren Weg zurück nach Paloma und sorgt für reichlich Chaos. Darsteller: Elise Eikermann, Flemming Stein, Robert Knorr, Roman Rossa, Kaya Malin Kröger, Linda Fölster, Anja Topf, Katharina von Keller, Selina Böttcher. Regie Ophélie Mahé, Mireille Tram

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E01 "Je první den nového školního roku a táta má za úkol dopravit děti včas do školy. Jenže zaspal a teď nemůže Gumballa, Darwina ani Anais nikde najít. Vydá se proto zpět po vlastních stopách, aby zjistil, co předchozího dne dělal a kde by mohli být."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E02 "Gumball s Darwinem zjistí, že Rob, který jim kdysi přísahal pomstu, se je už nějakou dobu snaží odrovnat… jenže jeho pasti nikdy nefungují. Slitují se nad ním a vytyčí si za cíl pomoct mu stát se perfektním úhlavním nepřítelem. Ale odvedou práci až moc dobře a stvoří superpadoucha, který by se mohl vymknout jejich kontrole…"

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E03 "Gumball s Darwinem usoudí, že je načase přidat se k někomu do party, a shodnou se, že nejdrsnější gang v celém Elmoru jsou důchodci. Dělají, co můžou, aby mezi ně zapadli, a neváhají zajít do krajnosti, jen aby jim (pomalu a šouravě) nadběhli."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E04 "Když Anais Gumballovi s Darwinem prozradí, že chodí o rok výš než oni, spadnou jim z očí šupiny a otevře se před nimi celý nový svět ostatních studentů Elmorské osmiletky. Gumballem otřese poznání, že mnohé z těchto postav o něm nemají takřka ponětí, a je plně odhodlán vnutit se jim do života."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E05 "Táta zjistí, že babi Jojo a Louie se plánují vzít a odstěhovat se na Floridu. Ve snaze tomu zabránit táta adoptuje Louieho, aby mu mohl zakázat oženit se s babi Jojo. Ale tím spustí řadu adopcí uvnitř rodiny, které se rychle vymknou kontrole a přivodí nečekaný návrat někoho z tátovy minulosti…"

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E09 "Gumball a Darwin obdrželi okázalou pozvánku na Masaminu narozeninovou oslavu a nyní horlivě usilují najít pro ni ideální dárek. Nejsou ale jediní; všechny děti v Elmoru soutěží o to, kdo pro Masami sežene perfektní dárek."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E16 "Gumball chce panu Fitzgeraldovi dokázat, že je hoden jeho dcery Penny, a rozhodne se stát se na jeden den jeho učněm. Potíž je v tom, že pan Fitzgerald má důležitý pohovor, a Gumballovy nadšené snahy pomáhat možná nadělají víc škody než užitku - jak firmě pana Fitzgeralda, tak Gumballově budoucnosti s Penny."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E06 "Typická stresující rodinná večeře u Wattersonových dotlačí mámu až na pokraj duševních sil, a tak Nicole začne vzpomínat, jak se seznámila s Richardem. Mohl být její život lepší, kdyby se tehdy vůbec nepustila do hovoru se svým budoucím manželem, a místo toho se vydala jinou cestou?"

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E07 "Gumball se dozví, že Wattersonovi už celé roky kradou wi-fi pana Robinsona. Když jednou wi-fi přestane fungovat, pokusí se žít bez ní. Ale život bez internetu se ukáže jako příliš těžký. Gumball s Darwinem se proto rozhodnou, že se prohackují kyberprostorem a zjistí Robinsonovo heslo."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E08 "Gumballa naštve, když mu v internetovém testu opakovaně vyjde, že je typ postavy zvaný ""Trapák"". Je přesvědčený, že se téhle nálepky zbaví jedině tak, že bude dělat přesný opak všeho, co dělá normálně. Jenže když Gumball potlačí svoje přirozené pudy, zanechá po sobě vakuum - díru ve tvaru Gumballa, kterou někdo musí zaplnit. A ten někdo je Tobias, který seriál začne proměňovat v otřepaný sitcom."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E09 "Náhodné setkání se ženou jeho snů přiměje Rockyho, aby přestal žít na internetu a začal hledat lásku pomocí nejnovější seznamovací aplikace. Gumball s Darwinem se Rockymu snaží pomoct proklestit si cestu ošidným světem vztahů přes internet. Při honbě za Rockyho vysněnou dívkou navíc zjistí, že když lidem řeknete, že jednáte ve jménu lásky, odpustí vám téměř cokoli."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E10 "Gumball s Darwinem dají Bobertovi vlastní pokyny, protože chtějí zajistit, aby se choval bezpečně a zodpovědně. Když Bobert začne na jejich pravidla aplikovat svoji robotickou logiku, rychle jim dojde, že se budou muset vyjadřovat mnohem jasněji. Jinak je nakonec všechny zničí…"

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E11 "Nicole se marně snaží skrýt zklamání, když Richard s dětmi zapomenou na její významný den. Richard musí přijít na to, na jaký významný den zapomněl, a dnešek učinit nezapomenutelným dnem, jinak bude zle!"

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E40 "Elmorské zprávy na Kanálu 6 vysílají ty nejžhavější místní příběhy od policejní honičky až po exkluzivní zprávu o Oslici Daisy. Zkušený hlasatel Kip Schlezinger je právě tím, kdo přináší nejnovější zprávy, také ze sportu a o počasí, i když není vůbec o čem referovat…"

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E15 "Nicole, která už má dost ošklivých dárků od babi Jojo, popíchne děti, aby vzaly věci do svých rukou a ""jako nehodu"" rozbili škaredou vázu od Jojo. Když se ji však Gumball, Darwin a Anais snaží zničit, zjistí, že je odolnější, než vypadá."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E19 "Když Darwin požádá Gumballa, aby ho naučil jezdit na skateboardu, Gumball se postará o to, aby se vyznal ve všech oblastech životního stylu skateboardingu - od správného oblečení přes správné výrazy až po výběr správného prkna. Jenže když se má Darwin nakonec rozjet, uvědomí si, že v jedné podstatné oblasti skateboardingu ho Gumball nenaučil nic..."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E13 "Když Darwin obědvá s Idahem, ze solidarity vůči svému bramborovému kamarádovi se rozhodne přestat jíst brambory. Jenže zbavit se posedlosti oblíbeným jídlem je pro něj nepředstavitelně obtížné, a tak se mu Gumball snaží pomoct udržet choutky na uzdě."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E26 "Gumball se odmítá smířit s tím, že jako jediný ze školy nemá zvláštní schopnosti. Přemluví paní Jötunheim, Hectorovu mámu, aby ho přijala za svého učně, ale brzy se ukáže, že nechat Gumballa kouzlit bez dozoru je velká chyba."

programme.desc: S03E22 Lamput je vědecký průlom století. Vnímavý super sliz, který se může přeměnit na cokoliv - pokud si zachová oranžovou barvu. Doktoři Brýlák a Hubeňour jsou vynálezci, kteří se zoufale snaží svůj vynález dostat z nebezpečných situací.

programme.desc: S05E18 "Když Gumball dostane prokletou herní konzoli, Elmore se stane součástí světa fantasy RPG hry. Gumball, Darwin a Anais si musejí probít cestu městem a odhalit tajemství nové virtuální reality. Musejí se nalevelovat, aby vůbec měli šanci proti závěrečnému bossovi."

programme.desc: S06E22 "Rodiče Penny jsou nespokojení, že se rozhodla zbavit své skořápky. Penny si přeje, aby i celá její rodina konečně opustila své skořápky. Rodina neví, na koho se má v této vyostřené situaci obrátit. Řešení je však nasnadě. Přece na Gumballa! I když tohle mu asi nebude moc příjemné..."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět

Peter Pepperoni se až doteď vzdělával doma a vytvořil si tak zvláštní způsob mluvy. Kvůli sérii nedorozumění se Darwin a Gumball ocitnou na útěku před zákonem."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět

Když své hosty, jimiž je párek postarších koz, náhle v domě překvapí, hosté omdlí a Wattersonovi, kteří se obávají nejhoršího, musí tuhle nehodu nějak zamaskovat."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S03E32 """Gumball, Darwin a Anais odhalí, že máma Banána Joea maluje obrázky, které předpovídají budoucnost. Když objeví jeden, na kterém Gumball pobíhá nahý po obchodním domě, Gumball nehodlá něco takového dopustit. Všechno se proti němu spikne a Gumball se tak naučí, že občas se s osudem bojovat nedá. / Když pan Small pustí ve třídě video ohledně zdraví a předcházení úrazům, Darwin začne být posedlý myšlenkou, že musí Wattersonovým zajistit bezpečí. Snaží se je chránit před okolním světem a brzy se Darwinova přehnaná ochrana rozšíří do všech koutů Elmoru. Wattersonovi nemají na vybranou. Musí svrhnout jeho despotický režim."""

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E03 "Gumball a Darwin podrobí Joshe, nového kamaráda Anais, sérii zkoušek, aby zjistili, jestli je pro jejich sestru dost dobrý. Jenomže extrémní přístup obou chlapců Joshe vyděsí, a tak si začne říkat, jestli mu Anais za všechny ty zkoušky stojí. A tak musí Gumball a Darwin Joshe přesvědčit, že má dát Anais ještě jednu šanci."

programme.desc: S01E01 Daffy a Porky hledají poklad ukrytý v Chrámu Opoptáka. / Marťan Marvin přistane na nové planetě a zabere ji "ve jménu Marsu". Kdykoli Marvin vlajku zapíchne, stane se něco nečekaného. / Yosemite Sam si dává páku s Bugsem Bunnym.

programme.title: Looney Tunes: Animáky

programme.desc: S04E01 "Je první den nového školního roku a táta má za úkol dopravit děti včas do školy. Jenže zaspal a teď nemůže Gumballa, Darwina ani Anais nikde najít. Vydá se proto zpět po vlastních stopách, aby zjistil, co předchozího dne dělal a kde by mohli být."

Slitují se nad ním a vytyčí si za cíl pomoct mu stát se perfektním úhlavním nepřítelem. Ale odvedou práci až moc dobře a stvoří superpadoucha, který by se mohl vymknout jejich kontrole…"

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E04 "Když Anais Gumballovi s Darwinem prozradí, že chodí o rok výš než oni, spadnou jim z očí šupiny a otevře se před nimi celý nový svět ostatních studentů Elmorské osmiletky. Gumballem otřese poznání, že mnohé z těchto postav o něm nemají takřka ponětí, a je plně odhodlán vnutit se jim do života."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E05 "Táta zjistí, že babi Jojo a Louie se plánují vzít a odstěhovat se na Floridu. Ve snaze tomu zabránit táta adoptuje Louieho, aby mu mohl zakázat oženit se s babi Jojo. Ale tím spustí řadu adopcí uvnitř rodiny, které se rychle vymknou kontrole a přivodí nečekaný návrat někoho z tátovy minulosti…"

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E09 "Gumball a Darwin obdrželi okázalou pozvánku na Masaminu narozeninovou oslavu a nyní horlivě usilují najít pro ni ideální dárek. Nejsou ale jediní; všechny děti v Elmoru soutěží o to, kdo pro Masami sežene perfektní dárek."

programme.title: Čas na dobrodružství: Vedlejší výpravy
programme.desc: S01E20 Finn a Jake najdou motokáru bez motoru, a tak se Jake stane motorem, ale při závodě s provokujícím loupežníkem jsou jeho schopnosti vystaveny těžké zkoušce.

programme.title: Čas na dobrodružství: Vedlejší výpravy
programme.desc: S01E08 Na mladého hrdinu Finna a kouzelného psa Jakea čeká spousta dobrodružství. Vydávají se za oblačnými lidmi a bojovat se zlem ve fantastické zemi Óóó.

programme.title: Normálka
programme.desc: S07E30 Bláznivé a neskutečné patálie Mordecaie a Rigbyho, nejlepších kamarádů, kteří každý den svádí boj s praštěným šéfem Bensonem.

programme.title: Normálka

programme.desc: S07E52 Titáni touží po tom, aby jejich 365. epizoda byla extra speciální. Vydají se proto hledat režiséra do studia Warner Bros.

programme.title: Mladí Titáni do toho!
programme.desc: S08E06 Komisař Gordon musí pracovat. Batman se k němu připojí na stanici a společně se baví při boji proti zločinu.

programme.title: Čas na dobrodružství
programme.desc: S01E01 "BMO se cestou na Mars setká s roztomilým mimozemšťanem přezdívaným ""Oliva"", který vychýlí jeho vesmírnou loď z kurzu, takže BMO nechtíc přistane na záhadné vesmírné stanici. Když zjistí, že stanici hrozí nebezpečí, najme jakožto místní samozvaný šerif podivnou zaječí bytost jménem Y5, aby mu pomohla stanici zachránit. Přinese jejich spolupráce úspěch, nebo budou dobré úmysly naší dvojice zmařeny?"

programme.title: Čas na dobrodružství
programme.desc: S01E02 Marcelína a princezna Žvýkačka vyrážejí na cesty to působivého a nádherného Skleněného království - a do hlubin jeho bouřlivé minulosti - aby zabránily katastrofě, která by mohla otřást celým světem.

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S02E33 Gumball a Darwin se snaží porozumět Jukeovu nouzovému rapovému vzkazu.

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S02E34 Wattersonovi jsou normální rodinka. Táta je růžový králík a stará se o děti, zatímco máma pracuje v továrně na duhu. Nejstarší z dětí je Gumball, modrý kocour, pak je tu geniální čtyřletá králičí holčička Anais a nakonec Darwin, zlatá rybka, které narostly nohy. Hlavním hrdinou příběhů je Gumball, který se potýká se stejnými problémy a výzvami jako ostatní dvanáctiletí kluci - třeba když musí prchat před útočícím Tyrannosaurem Rexem nebo spát pod mostem, protože mu robot ukradne totožnost, nebo se má převléknout za roztleskávačku a dělat roznožky, aby udělal dojem na dívku svých snů. Vítejte v Gumballově úžasném světě, ve kterém je všechno normální tak trochu divne.

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S02E35 Gumballovi a Darwinovi se nepodaří uskutečnit jejich sen o doma natočeném filmovém trháku.
